## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

✅ **Gate recommendation: approve.**

Keeping batching inside the OpenAI provider addresses large writes without applying its request limit to other embedding functions. The sequential batches preserve row alignment, and a failed request still rejects the write before database ingestion.
